title: Laravel AI SDK 1.1 Adds Agent Skills and Cohere Chat
content:
Laravel AI SDK 1.1 adds Agent Skills support, Cohere text generation, approval for built-in tools, and failover that skips provider tools a provider lacks.

The post Laravel AI SDK 1.1 Adds Agent Skills and Cohere Chat appeared first on Laravel News.
